I will send numbered items like "07. fruit-veg-apple: a single red apple with one green leaf".

STYLE (identical for every image in this conversation):
- Hand-painted editorial illustration, soft gouache texture with fine paper grain, rounded natural shapes, gentle warm daylight.
- Palette: lavender, deep indigo, mint and warm peach accents on natural colors.
- One main subject, centered, fully visible, filling about 70% of the frame.
- Plain soft off-white background with a faint lavender halo. Only show surroundings when the item is a place, an action, a weather or a time of day.
- Square 1:1, 1024x1024.
- People: adults, diverse in age and ethnicity, friendly natural expressions; elegant, not childish, not cartoonish, not photorealistic.

NEVER: text, letters, numbers, signs, labels, logos, brands, watermarks, frames, borders, collages or several panels. No real people.
Each image must make the meaning of the word obvious to a beginner who cannot read the language.

Wait for my first item.
